title: Refuse stale id counters in roadmap derive

completion.statement: roadmap.py derive now fails closed on stale id counters: check_id_counters runs under the board lock before any mint or write and refuses (exit 2, one board: message naming the counter and the true maximum, zero files written) when next_story_id/next_epic_id do not exceed every existing record id or when the minted id would collide with an existing record file. Counter repair stays an explicit operator edit of meta.json. Id-join, never-reuse and build-order semantics are unchanged. Four new DeriveTests cases cover the stale story-counter refusal, the stale epic-counter refusal, the record-file collision, and the happy path after explicit repair; the documented safe add-a-story flow in references/recovery.md and the mission library notes now matches the refusal behavior. The full sha is recorded in the board record history for story 35.
evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_board.py (48 tests OK, incl. 4 new DeriveTests cases that failed pre-fix with exit 0 on a stale counter)

manual derive in a $TMPDIR repo: stale next_story_id=1 -> exit 2 with 'meta.json next_story_id is 1 but story id 3 already exists', shasum snapshot of .software-factory identical before/after (zero writes); explicit repair to max+1 -> derive exit 0; record file stories/4.json holding id 3 with counter 4 -> exit 2 naming stories/4.json, file intact
